notes.title: Made a big mistake, game should work again!
notes.content:
Soooo, this is kinda embarrassing, but last patch I did I forgot to turn off the debug controls I use. This is why ESCAPE made the game quit instead of making it open your inventory, which virtually made the game unplayable! It also caused some other problems.

Sorry about that! The game should work fine now again!
Windows build is live and macosx will come later today!
